spec.description: APM view of the services that send traces to Tempo, keyed on service.name. Request rate, errors and latency come from Tempo metrics-generator span metrics and service-graph metrics in Mimir; logs come from Loki by systemd unit. Adapted from the Lightweight APM for OpenTelemetry dashboard (backlog item 513, 2026-11-08).

spec.title: Duration
spec.description: Built on Tempo metrics-generator span metrics (`traces_spanmetrics_*`). Latency of the service's inbound spans (span kind server or consumer).

spec.title: Error
spec.description: Built on Tempo metrics-generator span metrics (`traces_spanmetrics_*`). Share of inbound spans (server or consumer) with status `STATUS_CODE_ERROR`.

spec.title: Request Rate
spec.description: Built on Tempo metrics-generator span metrics (`traces_spanmetrics_*`). Inbound spans (server or consumer) per second.

spec.title: Inbound Operations
spec.description: Built on Tempo metrics-generator span metrics (`traces_spanmetrics_*`). Inbound operations of the service by span name (span kind server or consumer). Errors are spans with status `STATUS_CODE_ERROR`.

spec.expr: (sum by (operation) (label_join(rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="$service_name", span_kind=~"SPAN_KIND_SERVER|SPAN_KIND_CONSUMER", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval]), "operation", "", "span_name")) / sum by (operation) (label_join(rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="$service_name", span_kind=~"SPAN_KIND_SERVER|SPAN_KIND_CONSUMER"}[$__rate_interval]), "operation", "", "span_name"))) or (0 * sum by (operation) (label_join(rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="$service_name", span_kind=~"SPAN_KIND_SERVER|SPAN_KIND_CONSUMER"}[$__rate_interval]), "operation", "", "span_name")))

spec.title: Outbound Calls
spec.description: Built on Tempo metrics-generator span metrics (`traces_spanmetrics_*`). Calls the service makes, by span name (span kind client or producer). Errors are spans with status `STATUS_CODE_ERROR`.

spec.expr: (sum by (outbound_service) (label_join(rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="$service_name", span_kind=~"SPAN_KIND_CLIENT|SPAN_KIND_PRODUCER", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval]), "outbound_service", "", "span_name")) / sum by (outbound_service) (label_join(rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="$service_name", span_kind=~"SPAN_KIND_CLIENT|SPAN_KIND_PRODUCER"}[$__rate_interval]), "outbound_service", "", "span_name"))) or (0 * sum by (outbound_service) (label_join(rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service="$service_name", span_kind=~"SPAN_KIND_CLIENT|SPAN_KIND_PRODUCER"}[$__rate_interval]), "outbound_service", "", "span_name")))

spec.title: Downstream Services
spec.description: Built on Tempo metrics-generator service-graph metrics (`traces_service_graph_*`). Services this service calls, with request rate, failed share and client-side p99 latency.

spec.expr: (sum by (downstream) (label_join(rate(traces_service_graph_request_failed_total{client="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]), "downstream", "", "server")) / sum by (downstream) (label_join(rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{client="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]), "downstream", "", "server"))) or (0 * sum by (downstream) (label_join(rate(traces_service_graph_request_total{client="$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]), "downstream", "", "server")))

spec.description:
Logs of the service's systemd unit (`grafana-<service>.service` for the grafana-stack containers, `<service>.service` otherwise).

To explore the logs, open the menu clicking on the icon `⋮` of this panel and click on `Explore`.
Traces containing a span emitted by the service

spec.title: Latest span metrics
spec.description: Shows the time of the latest span metrics for the service in the past 24h.

spec.title: Latest logs received
spec.description: Shows the time of the latest log line from the service's systemd unit (`grafana-<service>.service` or `<service>.service`) in the past 24h.

spec.title: Latest traces received
spec.description: Shows the timestamp of the latest span received in the past 24h.
